uniteDbPokemon.notes: Unite-DB public pokemon.json. v3 enumerates skills, boosted basic attacks, nested upgrade choices, Plus/enhanced effects, Unite Moves, and Unite Buffs.

sourceList.originalDescription: This Pokémon can catch some form of prey in their mouth while moving through Whirlpool, Surf, or Dive. When receiving damage, counterattacks by spitting the prey in their mouth at an opposing Pokémon, damaging them and bouncing to 1 other opposing Pokémon nearby. When above 50% max HP, catches Arrokuda as prey, which also decrease opposing Pokémon's Defense by 20% and Sp. Def by 5% for 3s. When below 50% max HP, instead catches Pikachu as prey, which decrease opposing Pokémon's movement speed by 50% and attack speed by 10% for 1s. When Cramorant uses a move, it catches some form of prey in its mouth. Afterward, when Cramorant receives damage, it spits the prey out as a counterattack at an enemy. The type of prey and effect differ based on the user's HP.

Becomes a boosted attack with every fourth attack, catching some form of prey. This boosted attack spits prey at an opposing Pokémon, damaging them and bouncing to 1 other opposing Pokémon nearby. Becomes a boosted attack with every fourth attack. This boosted attack spits Arrokuda or other Pokémon at the enemy and deals area damage near the target when it hits.
Becomes a boosted attack with every fourth attack. This boosted attack spits Arrokuda or other Pokémon at the enemy and deals area damage near the target when it hits.

The user creates a whirlpool at a designated location, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect over 1.8s (up to 10 times). The area of effect shrinks in size over the duration; opposing Pokémon standing at the outer edge of the whirlpool are hit only up to 3 times. The movement speed of opposing Pokémon in the area of effect is decreased by 50% for 0.2s when hit. The user can enter the whirlpool to catch prey for Gulp Missile (up to 2 times). Creates a whirlpool that deals damage to enemies in the area of effect. The area of effect slowly shrinks, but the damage dealt slowly increases. Just before the whirlpool disappears, it decreases the movement speed of enemies in the area of effect for a short time. The user can also catch Arrokuda or other prey by entering the whirlpool.

The user sends a wave in the designated direction, damaging opposing Pokémon in the wave. The wave reaches its maximum distance after 0.8s, then returns to its starting point at the same speed, damaging opposing Pokémon and pulling them with the returning wave, stunning them for 0.4s during the pull. The user catches prey with the first wave, and can enter the returning wave to catch more prey for Gulp Missile. Attacks with a wave that deals damage to enemies. Once the wave has traveled its full distance, it returns the way it came, dealing damage to enemies once again and pulling them back with the wave. The user can also catch Arrokuda or other prey by entering the wave.
The first wave decreases the movement speed of opposing Pokémon hit by 40% for 3s. When the first wave hits enemies, it also decreases their movement speed for a short time.

The user becomes unstoppable for 0.5s as they change the designated location into a puddle then dive to the puddle, damaging opposing Pokémon and shoving them for 0.5s when the user emerges from the puddle. The next boosted attack within 5s deals additional damage; boosted attacks after 5s have passed become regular boosted attacks. A maximum of 3 uses can be kept in reserve for this move, and there is a 2s cooldown between uses. The user catches prey for Gulp Missile as they emerge from the puddle. Changes the designated area into a puddle and has the user dive to that area, dealing damage to enemies and shoving them when they're hit. The user also catches Arrokuda or other wild Pokémon as they emerge from the puddle. A maximum of 3 uses can be kept in reserve for this move.
Increases the damage of the dive. Increased damage.

The user throws a circle of feathers at the designated area, decreasing the Attack of opposing Pokémon in the area of effect by 30% and their movement speed by 20% for 4s. Decreases the Attack and movement speed of enemies for a short time.

The user creates a fierce wind at the designated location. After 0.5s, a hurricane catches opposing Pokémon in the area of effect, damaging them and throwing them for 1s. Afterwards the user's attack speed increases by 40% for 3s. Creates a fierce wind, dealing damage to enemies that get caught in it and throws them.
Increases the user's movement speed by 20% for 3s. Increases the user's movement speed for a short time.

The user shoots out 5 blades of air in a cone in the designated direction, damaging the first opposing Pokémon hit with each blade. The user also hops backward to create distance. This move's cooldown is reduced by 0.8s for each blade that hits (up to 4s). Shoot out many blades of air while moving backward to create distance. Deals damage to enemies in the area of effect and reduces this move's cooldown when it hits.
Restores the user's HP for each blade of air that hits an opposing Pokémon. Restores the user's HP every time a blade of air hits an enemy.

The user becomes unstoppable for up to 6.5s and catches a series of prey to spit at the nearest Pokémon from the opposing team or wild Pokémon up to 10 times. The user cannot move or use moves while using Gatling Gulp Missile. The user can use this Unite Move again to cancel it early. The prey caught for each Gatling Gulp Missile attack depends on the user's current HP. If a boosted attack is readied when this Unite Move is used, the user spits this prey out first as a regular boosted attack before catching and spitting out up to 10 Gatling Gulp Missile prey. Creates a puddle at the user's current location. The user continuously uses its mouth to grab Arrokuda from the puddle and spits them out to attack the nearest enemy. The user cannot move or use other moves while this move is in effect.
Buffs: 30% Max HP Shield granted at the start of the Move, 30% Movement Speed granted at the end of the turret Buff duration: 6

The user cannot move or use other moves while this move is in effect.
